scope: Read-only comparison of retained BTC project and starting English ETH edition. Baseline precedes colleague-facing revision.

matrix.btc_depth: Three measured conclusions before the market
matrix.eth_baseline: Four statistical cards and a technical description
matrix.action_and_boundary: Add three or four complete, plain-English takeaways with one supporting number and one implication each. Use existing matched returns, leverage, carry allocation and Concrete ownership.

matrix.btc_depth: Selected netted categories, optional C7/C8 and excluded products
matrix.eth_baseline: 5,688 candidate pools, 87 selected protocol sources, explicit unknown global net total
matrix.action_and_boundary: Keep the screening sum separate from market size. Add a coverage table explaining the size of each verified segment and why those segments cannot be summed. No global net pie chart until the graph is complete.

matrix.btc_depth: Ranked scan with a definition, threshold and documented exclusions
matrix.eth_baseline: Five comparison products with different mechanisms and verification depth
matrix.action_and_boundary: Explain why these five were chosen. Call it a research sample rather than a verified top five by external equity. Add notable excluded, private or unmeasured product classes.

matrix.btc_depth: Broad market coverage plus venue-specific borrower follow-up
matrix.eth_baseline: Ten focus chains in discovery; most deep fixed-block work is Ethereum, Optimism, Base and Arbitrum
matrix.action_and_boundary: Separate “included in discovery” from “reconstructed at a fixed block.” Add chain-specific measurement notes. BNB, Tron, Linea and smaller material sleeves still need exact root-backing and borrower work.

matrix.btc_depth: Market categories and dated reclassification
matrix.eth_baseline: Nine mechanics with payers, formulas and risks
matrix.action_and_boundary: Preserve E1–E9. Add an everyday example before equations and define ETH loop, dollar carry and dollar basis in one paragraph. Mechanism TVL remains unmeasured, so do not turn category hints into a strategy-capital total.

matrix.btc_depth: One-BTC Kraken example with reward and fee split
matrix.eth_baseline: Generic calculators plus real account sensitivities
matrix.action_and_boundary: Add a 100-ETH worked loop example and a clearly illustrative dollar-carry example. Distinguish account equity from whole-product NAV. Use the verified Aave parameters for the loop; do not label an unmeasured carry split as actual Liquid ETH P&L.

matrix.btc_depth: Liquid BTC covers complete funded monthly portfolios within 0.5%
matrix.eth_baseline: Liquid ETH partial reconstruction has a 2.634% residual; nested claims remain book-valued
matrix.action_and_boundary: Show a balance-sheet waterfall and explain what is included in each line. Group accounts, carry claims, LP and nested vaults without double counting. Keep “97.37% explained by selected claim valuation” distinct from “97.37% physically audited.”

matrix.btc_depth: Dated regime tables, debt venues and controlled managers
matrix.eth_baseline: Current strategy details and matched PPS; historical portfolio composition open
matrix.action_and_boundary: Add only dated regime events established by logs or disclosures. A current 64.66% carry UI allocation cannot explain the full two-year return. Reconstruct month-end positions and debt before attributing excess to carry or looping.

matrix.btc_depth: Debt-weighted interest, rewards, fees and net PPS compared over time
matrix.eth_baseline: PPS and issuer conversion returns; no complete portfolio P&L
matrix.action_and_boundary: Add return stability, benchmark excess and share-rate contribution from captured series. Complete interest indices, reward beneficiaries and claim-time prices are needed for organic/reward attribution.

matrix.btc_depth: Deposits, withdrawals, yield and price decomposed; concentrated flow drivers identified
matrix.eth_baseline: Liquid ETH supplies and rates at 33 points; protocol USD observations
matrix.action_and_boundary: Derive the exact share-supply and accounting-rate decomposition of book NAV. Name the first component “share-supply effect,” not real cash inflow. Preserve bridge and in-flight boundaries. Protocol USD growth alone is not a flow series.

matrix.btc_depth: Holder buckets, top-N shares, wallet types, look-through and cohorts
matrix.eth_baseline: Concrete concentrated holdings; no comparable Liquid ETH/Fluid/Treehouse/CIAN holder census
matrix.action_and_boundary: Complete Transfer replay or paginated holders with balances at T; unwrap lending/queue/bridge custody; separate addresses from people. A borrower scan is not a depositor census.

matrix.btc_depth: 29–110 events per flagship, connected to exposure and growth
matrix.eth_baseline: 66 Liquid ETH non-rate Accountant events, plus incident sources
matrix.action_and_boundary: Expose fee and payout changes as a chronology now. Keep operational/configuration events separate from deposits and causal growth claims. Collect deployment, withdrawal, market-cap and strategy events for full product timelines.

matrix.btc_depth: Specific roles, signers, key powers, timelocks and bypasses
matrix.eth_baseline: Specific owned managers; a 24-hour authority timelock; Concrete 3-of-5 Safe
matrix.action_and_boundary: Present a “who can change what” table with verified and unresolved columns. Read RolesAuthority capabilities and historical role events; getMinDelay alone does not establish a delay on ordinary authorized strategy calls.

matrix.btc_depth: Audit scope, bounty, pauses, liquidation records and executed response
matrix.eth_baseline: rsETH incident explanation, reserve deficits and selected oracle verification
matrix.action_and_boundary: Map audit reports to the actual implementation/modules. Add observed pause/withdrawal incidents and fund recovery by product. Do not infer no exploit or no liquidation from absence of a searched event set.

matrix.btc_depth: Published versus executable NAV, withdrawal quotes and dated gates
matrix.eth_baseline: Documented exit fees, queue state, reserve cash; simulations open
matrix.action_and_boundary: Add a one-fee return illustration to comparison. Label it a cost model. Build repayment and redemption ladders in the required asset, with competing-withdrawal assumptions. Cash and documentation do not establish successful execution.

matrix.btc_depth: Intraday LTV, negative-carry duration, repayment lag and realized exits
matrix.eth_baseline: Fixed-state account shocks and model break-even
matrix.action_and_boundary: Keep snapshots as sensitivities. Reconstruct account histories and transactions to measure manager response. Do not borrow Kraken's 40–48-hour lag or BTC liquidation formula for an ETH-debt loop.

matrix.btc_depth: 319 positions, multiple venues and subsequent identification
matrix.eth_baseline: 237 top-N positions across 25 selected Morpho markets; pilot Aave accounts
matrix.action_and_boundary: Aggregate the existing selected positions by chain/address and measure top borrower shares within that sample. State its coverage and timing. Full Aave, Spark, Fluid and other-chain enumeration remains needed for a carry census.

matrix.btc_depth: Fee claims, splitters, downstream fees and subsidy budget
matrix.eth_baseline: Liquid ETH fee state and 26 captured fee claims; carry-curator fees
matrix.action_and_boundary: Add asset-separated fee totals and dated changes. Current fee × current NAV gives a hypothetical run-rate, not earned revenue. Claim balances need issuer conversion at claim time before summing assets; recipient identity and intercompany splits remain unknown.

matrix.btc_depth: Explicit lifecycle, emissions and excluded segments
matrix.eth_baseline: General staking/LRT note, Pendle catalogue, brief options mechanic
matrix.action_and_boundary: Expand issuer/payer/fee/redemption differences and identify genuinely unmeasured AVS reward income. Measure PT outstanding supply and SY backing, rather than AMM liquidity. Build an options product catalogue before assigning a segment total.

matrix.btc_depth: Midas/Maple passports distinguish ownership, unsecured/subordinated claims and settlement
matrix.eth_baseline: PRIME credit disclosure and explicit verification limits
matrix.action_and_boundary: Add holder rights only where current primary terms support them. On-chain collateral and a case study do not establish lender enforcement or beneficial ownership. Keep documented rights distinct from inference.

matrix.btc_depth: Maple, Hermetica, Acre, migrations and ceased yield displayed separately
matrix.eth_baseline: Expired PT and legacy contracts distinguished; no broad shutdown catalogue
matrix.action_and_boundary: Add a lifecycle table for captured expired/legacy products. Track residual principal separately from active strategy size. Do not assume 122 expired PT markets hold zero capital.

matrix.btc_depth: Each operational rule is connected to a measured failure or constraint
matrix.eth_baseline: Six strong general product insights
matrix.action_and_boundary: State a few decisions plainly: benchmark after exit, publish a readable balance sheet, budget rate headroom, separate credit and liquidity, disclose fee changes. Keep numeric operating limits illustrative unless the capacity analysis supports them.

carry_total_reconciliation.explanation: Noon has no historical series. REPORT.md retains historical9,278 in some current prose; current category correctly rounds9,316.

new_collection_required: Global root backing and external equity netting
Complete historical product positions and realized reward/interest attribution
Holder cohorts and beneficial ownership look-through
Historical manager response and complete roles/capabilities
PT supply/SY backing, AVS payers and options product census
derivation_caveat: Fixed-state book illustrations, not executed payouts, verified cash flows, or complete portfolio P&L.
